# EntityRoll <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Entities](Blitz3D-Entities)

</div>


```blitzbasic
EntityRoll:Float32 entity:Int32, global:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | Entity handle. |
| `global` | In | Int32 | `0` | 1 for the angle in the world. Defaults to 0. |

**Returns:** Roll angle of the entity, relative to its parent or with `global` set to 1 in the world.

## Description

Reads the rotation around Z in degrees.
